description: This file defines the BlockReferenceNode class in Twig, representing a node for a block call within a Twig template. It includes constructor and compile methods related to rendering block content.

classes.name: Twig\Node\BlockReferenceNode
classes.description: Represents a block call node in Twig, used to generate code for rendering blocks within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new BlockReferenceNode with the block name and source line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to yield from a block, integrating debugging info.
